label: Insect / Macro
description: Macro-scale subjects — pair with the 100mm macro lens and focus stacking.

items.name: morpho-butterfly
items.text: a blue morpho wings-open on a dark leaf, structural blue shifting toward violet at the wing edges, brown owl-eye underwings just showing

items.name: dragonfly
items.text: a dragonfly grounded by cold, dew strung along every wing vein, compound eyes fogged with micro-droplets

items.name: jewel-beetle
items.text: a jewel beetle crossing a lichened twig, metallic elytra cycling green, gold and copper with every shift of the light

items.name: honeybee
items.text: a honeybee deep in a poppy, pollen baskets on its hind legs packed orange, loose pollen gilding every branched hair

items.name: praying-mantis
items.text: a praying mantis tracking the lens, triangular head swiveling on a neck no other insect has, spiked forelegs folded in wait

items.name: jumping-spider
items.text: a jumping spider's huge headlamp eye pair filling the frame, iridescent green chelicerae below, one dew drop balanced on its brow

items.name: ant-teamwork
items.text: leafcutter ants hauling green leaf sails along a branch highway, tiny guard workers riding the cargo against parasitic flies

items.name: snail-glass
items.text: a garden snail crossing glass shot from below, muscular ripple waves of its foot visible through the pane, eye stalks periscoping

items.name: moth-frost
items.text: an emperor moth stiff with overnight frost, furred thorax rimed white, motionless until the sun can warm its flight muscles

items.name: ladybird-takeoff
items.text: a ladybird at the instant of takeoff, red wing cases flipped open, membranous flight wings unfolding to four times their packed length

items.name: orchid-mantis
items.text: an orchid mantis posed among real orchid petals, limbs flushed pink and petal-lobed, indistinguishable from the flower until it strikes

items.name: glasswing-butterfly
items.text: a glasswing butterfly resting on a fern, transparent wing panes bending the scene behind them, only the veins and amber borders solid

items.name: stag-beetle-duel
items.text: two stag beetles locked antler-jaw to antler-jaw on an oak limb, one hoisted clean off its feet at the top of the throw

items.name: damselfly-wheel
items.text: a damselfly pair joined in a mating wheel, electric-blue bodies arched into a heart shape above a reed

items.name: cicada-eclosion
items.text: a cicada in mid-eclosion, pale and soft-bodied, hauling itself out of its split amber shell as crumpled wings slowly inflate

items.name: firefly-synchrony
items.text: synchronous fireflies pulsing the same beat through a dark understory, cold yellow-green light with no heat in it, each wave answered on down the hillside

items.name: monarch-cluster
items.text: overwintering monarch butterflies clustered in their thousands on oyamel fir boughs, branches bowing under the living load, a spill of wings flickering open where sun breaks through

items.name: bumblebee-buzz
items.text: a bumblebee buzz-pollinating a nightshade flower, jaws clamped on the anther cone, flight muscles shivering at a musical pitch until pollen pours out
